title: A New Queen Changes Nothing
setup: Black's king is on h8, and its pawn on e2 will become a queen on the very next move.
hint: Let Black have the queen. What matters is whether the new piece can reach the mating square in time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qf7}} covers g8 and g7 and refuses to be distracted. {{e1=Q}} makes a queen that is nowhere near h8, and {{Bf6#}} mates on the diagonal. Material is irrelevant when the opponent must move and every move loses.
